title: Applied AI Engineer Roadmap
summary: A step‑by‑step guide to go from no experience to building LLM‑powered products and landing a role. It covers fundamentals, core AI engineering skills, portfolio projects, and job‑ready preparation.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Learn programming basics and core AI concepts.

milestones.title: Python Basics
milestones.outcome: Write scripts, functions, and simple data pipelines in Python.

tasks.title: Complete Python intro on freeCodeCamp
tasks.description: Follow the freeCodeCamp Python basics module and finish all exercises.

tasks.title: Write a script to read and summarize a text file
tasks.description: Use built‑in file I/O to load a .txt file and print a short summary using basic string methods.

tasks.title: Practice list comprehensions with sample data
tasks.description: Create a list of numbers and filter/map them using list comprehensions.

tasks.title: Reflect on common Python errors
tasks.description: Write a short note about the errors you encountered and how you fixed them.

milestones.title: Intro to Machine Learning
milestones.outcome: Explain supervised learning, model evaluation, and basic neural network ideas.

tasks.title: Watch Andrew Ng’s ML intro videos on Coursera (audit)
tasks.description: Watch the first two lecture videos covering linear regression and classification.

tasks.title: Implement linear regression with scikit‑learn
tasks.description: Load the Boston housing dataset, fit a LinearRegression model, and print RMSE.

tasks.title: Practice splitting data into train/test sets
tasks.description: Write code that uses train_test_split and verifies shapes.

tasks.title: Connect with a ML community forum
tasks.description: Post a question about model evaluation on the Kaggle discussion board and read two replies.

milestones.title: Web Fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Create a simple static web page and serve it locally.

tasks.title: Read MDN HTML & CSS basics
tasks.description: Study the introductory articles on HTML elements and CSS styling.

tasks.title: Build a personal portfolio page
tasks.description: Write index.html and style.css to showcase a brief bio and links.

tasks.title: Serve the page with Python’s http.server
tasks.description: Run `python -m http.server` and verify the page loads in a browser.

tasks.title: Reflect on web development workflow
tasks.description: Note the steps from editing code to seeing changes in the browser.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Master LLM APIs, prompt design, and retrieval‑augmented generation.

milestones.title: LLM API Basics
milestones.outcome: Call OpenAI or Anthropic APIs to generate text from prompts.

tasks.title: Read OpenAI API quickstart guide
tasks.description: Study the official OpenAI documentation for authentication and request format.

tasks.title: Write a script that calls chat completion
tasks.description: Use the openai Python library to send a prompt and print the response.

tasks.title: Practice handling API errors
tasks.description: Add try/except blocks to catch rate‑limit and authentication errors.

tasks.title: Connect with the OpenAI community Discord
tasks.description: Introduce yourself and ask a question about best practices for prompt length.

milestones.title: Prompt Design
milestones.outcome: Craft effective prompts and use techniques like few‑shot, chain‑of‑thought, and role prompting.

tasks.title: Study prompt engineering guide on PromptBase blog
tasks.description: Read the sections on instruction clarity and output formatting.

tasks.title: Create three variants of a math‑question prompt
tasks.description: Write prompts using zero‑shot, few‑shot, and chain‑of‑thought styles and compare outputs.

tasks.title: Practice evaluating prompt quality
tasks.description: Score each response on relevance and correctness using a simple rubric.

tasks.title: Reflect on what changed the results
tasks.description: Write a brief note on why certain prompt styles performed better.

milestones.title: Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG)
milestones.outcome: Integrate vector stores and retrieval steps into LLM pipelines.

tasks.title: Read LangChain RAG tutorial on docs.langchain.com
tasks.description: Follow the step‑by‑step guide that builds a simple document retriever.

tasks.title: Build a FAISS index for sample PDFs
tasks.description: Extract text with PyPDF2, embed with OpenAI embeddings, and store in FAISS.

tasks.title: Practice querying the index with a prompt
tasks.description: Write code that retrieves top‑k chunks and feeds them to the LLM for answer generation.

tasks.title: Connect with a RAG meetup on Meetup.com
tasks.description: Attend a virtual meetup and ask a question about chunk size selection.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Create portfolio projects that showcase end‑to‑end AI products.

milestones.title: Document Q&A App with Citations
milestones.outcome: Deploy a web app that answers questions from uploaded documents and shows source snippets.

tasks.title: Design app architecture on paper
tasks.description: Sketch components: upload, vector store, retrieval, LLM response, citation UI.

tasks.title: Implement backend with FastAPI
tasks.description: Create endpoints for file upload, indexing, and query handling.

tasks.title: Build frontend using React (or plain HTML)
tasks.description: Create a simple UI that sends queries and displays answers with citations.

tasks.title: Deploy to Render free tier
tasks.description: Configure a Render service, push code, and verify the live URL works.

tasks.title: Write a project README and blog post
tasks.description: Explain problem, tech stack, and how RAG is used; publish on GitHub and personal site.

milestones.title: Tool‑Using AI Agent
milestones.outcome: Build an autonomous agent that can browse the web or run code to accomplish tasks.

tasks.title: Read LangChain agent tutorial
tasks.description: Follow the official guide that creates a web‑search agent.

tasks.title: Implement an agent that fetches weather data
tasks.description: Use the OpenAI function‑calling feature to call a weather API and return results.

tasks.title: Practice adding a new tool (calculator)
tasks.description: Extend the agent with a simple arithmetic tool and test it.

tasks.title: Connect with an AI agents Discord channel
tasks.description: Share your agent demo and solicit feedback from peers.

tasks.title: Document limitations and next steps
tasks.description: Write a short analysis of failure cases and how to improve robustness.

milestones.title: Prompt Evaluation Harness
milestones.outcome: Run systematic experiments to compare prompt variants on accuracy and cost.

tasks.title: Study evaluation metrics on the LLM Evaluation paper
tasks.description: Read the relevant section of the paper and note precision, recall, and cost metrics.

tasks.title: Build a script that runs batch prompts
tasks.description: Loop over a CSV of inputs, call the API, and store responses with timestamps.

tasks.title: Practice computing metric scores
tasks.description: Write functions to calculate exact match and token usage per prompt.

tasks.title: Connect with evaluation researchers on Twitter
tasks.description: Follow three experts and comment on a recent evaluation thread.

tasks.title: Write a short report of findings
tasks.description: Summarize which prompt style performed best and why, include charts.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Advance topics, polish portfolio, and prepare for job or freelance work.

milestones.title: Advanced Prompting & Guardrails
milestones.outcome: Design safe prompts and implement content filters for production use.

tasks.title: Read OpenAI safety best practices page
tasks.description: Study the official guidance on prompt injection and toxic content handling.

tasks.title: Build a wrapper that sanitizes user input
tasks.description: Implement a function that removes disallowed words before sending to the LLM.

tasks.title: Practice testing edge cases
tasks.description: Create a list of adversarial prompts and verify the guardrail blocks them.

tasks.title: Reflect on trade‑offs of strict vs. lenient filters
tasks.description: Write a brief note on user experience versus safety.

milestones.title: Scalable Shipping of Web Apps
milestones.outcome: Deploy AI services with CI/CD, monitoring, and cost control.

tasks.title: Read AWS Elastic Beanstalk free tier guide
tasks.description: Follow the tutorial to deploy a Flask app on Elastic Beanstalk.

tasks.title: Set up GitHub Actions for automated tests
tasks.description: Create a workflow that runs pytest on each push.

tasks.title: Practice adding logging and error alerts
tasks.description: Integrate Python logging and configure a simple email alert for failures.

tasks.title: Connect with a DevOps meetup group
tasks.description: Attend a virtual session and ask about cost‑monitoring for AI APIs.

milestones.title: Job‑Ready Portfolio & Interview Prep
milestones.outcome: Present a polished portfolio and answer technical interview questions confidently.

tasks.title: Create a one‑page portfolio site on GitHub Pages
tasks.description: Showcase the three projects with screenshots, live links, and tech stack details.

tasks.title: Practice explaining a RAG pipeline aloud
tasks.description: Record a 2‑minute video describing the flow from document ingestion to answer generation.

tasks.title: Solve 5 LLM‑focused interview questions on LeetCode discuss
tasks.description: Write code for prompt parsing, token counting, and API rate limiting.

tasks.title: Connect with a recruiter on LinkedIn
tasks.description: Send a personalized message sharing your portfolio and ask for feedback.

tasks.title: Reflect on feedback and update portfolio
tasks.description: Incorporate any suggestions and note improvements made.
